paks.name: WeRead
paks.description: A native WeRead client for TrimUI handhelds.
paks.author: Lin0u0

changelog.v0.1.10: Split the reader and UI runtime into dedicated modules, hardened reader/article parsing and progress/session handling, and added package launcher audit smoke coverage.
changelog.v0.1.3: Improved reader layout, restored system OSD hotkeys, and added tg5040 haptic feedback.
changelog.v0.1.4: Polished reader navigation with smoother catalog selection, confirm-to-exit from reading, and faster nearby shelf cover loading. Also refactored reader and UI helpers into dedicated modules for easier maintenance.
changelog.v0.1.5: Reduced CPU usage and device heat during idle reading and browsing with event-driven sleep, non-blocking haptics, and smarter render skipping.
changelog.v0.1.6: Hardened the TrimUI release path with preflight diagnostics, package archive audits for NextUI/Stock/CrossMix, and CI that now runs the same verified make-based release flow as maintainers.
changelog.v0.1.7: Added first-class WeRead article support with separate shelf handling, article catalogs and font sizing, smoother cross-chapter paging, faster catalog opening, and cooler shelf idle behavior.
changelog.v0.1.8: Added real cover art for公众号文章, normalized qlogo cover URLs, and fixed the shelf rendering path so article covers stay visible even when the first normal book is selected.
changelog.v0.1.9: Reworked the centered catalog flow with reliable held scrolling and safer chapter jumps, improved article opening and parsing, and moved tg5040 haptics off the render path.

paks.name: SideB
paks.description: Retro cassette-style player for TrimUI Brick with Spotify Connect, offline favorites, local MP3 playback, smart caching, and download progress
paks.author: CharlexH

changelog.v1.0.4: Added ffmpeg-lite packaging, improved runtime logging, fixed Spotify takeover of local playback, and upgraded FAV LIST navigation with wrap-around and hold-to-repeat controls.
changelog.v1.0.5: Smart multi-candidate YouTube search with duration scoring, post-download validation, real-time download progress in FAV LIST, and automatic resume of incomplete downloads on startup.
changelog.v1.0.6: Major performance optimization: 3x faster rendering (87ms → 25ms per frame), eliminated CPU busy-waiting, fast alpha blending, reduced device temperature by ~25°C during playback.

paks.name: Itch-io
paks.description: Browse and download GB/GBC games from Itch.io's GB Studio collection.
paks.author: Carroarmato0

changelog.v1.0.0: Initial release — browse and download free and paid GB/GBC games from itch.io's GB Studio collection, with built-in content filters.
changelog.v1.0.10:
• Add support for Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Devanagari, Greek, and many more non-CJK fonts.
• Fix issue preventing to exit the app when Cloudflare blocks the connection.
• Rewrite of the build system to leverage NextUI's own toolchains, allowing the use of the native SDL library on the devices and reducing the size of the Pak.
• Some UI fixes.
• Fix launching on Miyoo Flip and TrimUI Smart Pro S.
• Support GIFs in cover art.
• New Inventory system for tracking downloaded ROMs, game updates and store removals.
• New Sorting category [DL] = Download, with Update section.
• Implement Power Control (standby and poweroff).
• Countermeasures for the "double input" hardware bug on my355.
• Log rotation.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc1:
• Add support for Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Devanagari, Greek, and many more non-CJK fonts.
• Allow exiting the Pak when Cloudflare is blocking the initial fetching of the game list.
• Rewrite build and release to use NextUI toolchains and switch to native SDL on device.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc2:
• Fix some UI issues.
• Prevent double input on my355.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc3:
• Support GIFs in cover art.
• Enhance inventory for tracking game updates or store removal.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc4:
• Implement Power Control (wakeup/poweroff).
• Fix double d-pad input on my355.
changelog.v1.0.2:
• Place app logs in correct folder location.
• Fix scripts and in-app version.
changelog.v1.0.3: Support alternative ROM location per file-type.
changelog.v1.0.4:
• Add advanced logging.
• Privacy obfuscation in logs.
• User agent string.
changelog.v1.0.5:
• Transparent game list caching.
• Better scrolling in general.
• Support Asian fonts through Noto Sans JP.
changelog.v1.0.6:
• More robust handling of Cloudflare checks.
• Improved cover art download.
• Handle game page with .zip filenames.
changelog.v1.0.7:
• Advanced logging.
• API key testing.
• Game inventory.
• File management.
• Purchase picker for games bought multiple times (individual and bundle).
• Shows bundle names in picker.
• Faster game detail scrolling.
• Fix cover art not shown properly.
changelog.v1.0.8: Fix the +50 owned games issue when the API returns an empty page response because there are not 51 games.
changelog.v1.0.9: Implement basic sorting in Game List.
